user.title: Daily Temperature Wave
user.description: A target temperature that follows the sun: highest at solar noon, lowest at solar midnight. Temperatures accept a unit, e.g. `20C` or `68F`.

data_description.name: Used for the device and entity names.
data_description.min_temp: Reached at solar midnight, e.g. `20C` or `68F`.
data_description.wave_spread: 1.0 is a plain sine wave. Higher values give a shorter, sharper warm peak; lower values a broader one.
data_description.step_resolution: The stepped sensors round to this, e.g. `1F` or `0.5C`.
data_description.step_interval: The stepped sensors hold each value this long, starting from midnight (e.g. 30 = on the hour and half hour).
data_description.solar_noon_override: Leave empty to calculate solar noon from your Home Assistant location.

error.invalid_temperature: Not a temperature; use a number with an optional unit, e.g. `20C` or `68F`.
error.invalid_step: Use a positive number with an optional unit, e.g. `1F` or `0.5C`.
error.min_max_invalid: The minimum temperature must be below the maximum.
